name: omni-tools
description: Privacy-friendly collection of browser-based tools for files, media, PDFs, text, data, and calculations

fields.name: WEB_PORT
fields.label: R1: Web Interface Port
fields.help: Host port used to open OmniTools in bridge mode. In Host Mode, OmniTools listens directly on NAS port 80.

fields.name: OMNI_TOOLS_NETWORK_MODE
fields.label: O1: Network
fields.help: Choose Create New Bridge for the recommended default, Host Mode, or an existing named Docker network. Bridge mode is normally sufficient and avoids occupying NAS port 80 directly.

fields.name: RESTART_POLICY
fields.label: O2: Restart Policy
fields.help: Controls whether the container restarts automatically.

fields.name: OMNI_TOOLS_IMAGE
fields.label: A1: Image
fields.help: Official OmniTools image. Change this only if you need a pinned version or another image source.

fields.name: OMNI_TOOLS_PORT_MAPPING
fields.label: A2: Bridge Port Mapping
fields.help: Automatically generated for bridge or an existing Docker network and removed in Host Mode.

fields.name: OMNI_TOOLS_CONTAINER_NAME
fields.label: Container Name
fields.help: EasyDocker sets the container name from the project name.

fields.name: OMNI_TOOLS_INTERNAL_PORT
fields.label: Internal Web Port
fields.help: Recipe-managed OmniTools web port inside the container.

ui.overview: OmniTools provides self-hosted utilities for images, video, audio, PDFs, text, JSON, CSV, dates, mathematics, and other everyday tasks.
what_happens: One lightweight OmniTools container will be created
The application will open on the selected host port
Files and other input are processed locally in the user's browser rather than uploaded to the OmniTools container
No persistent storage folder, database, account, or generated secret is required
Browser bookmarks and similar interface preferences may remain in that browser's local storage rather than on the NAS
Bridge networking is selected by default, with Host Mode and existing Docker networks also available
ui.data_location: OmniTools is a stateless browser application and does not require a bind-mounted data folder. Keep original files backed up normally before performing any conversion or editing task.
